name: Balanced brackets validator
instruction: Implement is_balanced(s) in brackets.py: return True iff every '(', '[' and '{' in s is matched by the correct closing bracket in the right order, and there are no unmatched closers. Ignore any non-bracket characters. The empty string is balanced. E.g. '([{}])'=True, '([)]'=False, '((('=False.
verifyCmd: python3 -c "from brackets import is_balanced as f; import sys; t=[('()[]{}',True),('([{}])',True),('(]',False),('([)]',False),('',True),('(((',False),('a(b)c',True)]; sys.exit(0 if all(f(s)==e for s,e in t) else 1)"
